audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. Impossible global automorphism-stability hypothesis and invalid application; Permutation of nontrivial tensor factors cannot lie in the extension kernel; Jordan orbit lengths and Clifford degree relations are inverted
limitations: Counterevidence: Definition9.1 and primary Ruh2010.04499v2 Theorem2.1 use the appropriate defect-preserving setting; missing subscript plausible.
Counterevidence: Canonical tensor-permutation extension exists with C_W(L0) in kernel. Primary BS Prop4.2 retains nontrivial D'(rho(v)) factor.
Counterevidence: Corrected degree ratio still yields part(c); later Lemma2.3 supplies additional Clifford construction.
Counterevidence: Sufficiency survives; actual Sylow argument checks involutions of Weyl quotient, the correct setting.
Counterevidence: Intended product central quotient exists; odd center error does not itself invalidate two-local calculations.
Counterevidence: Proof words use scalar central characters; Proposition12.10 parity independently verified.
Counterevidence: Lemma2.3 p11 consistently uses st.
Limitations: Focused verification of the existing Problems only; no fresh whole-paper proof review.
Limitations: General classification and all external representation-theory dependencies were not reproved.
Limitations: The 2025 journal text was not inspected and is not the object of these findings.
Limitations: The complete repaired F01/F02 global argument is not certified.
Limitations: Full acceptance gates and delivery state are owned by the parent agent.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.
